title: Psychedelic Portrait
description: A woman with short brown hair faces forward, her face, neck and shoulders covered in vibrant psychedelic body paint. She is positioned in front of a large, intricate background filled with concentric circles, mandalas, and radiating tie-dye patterns in vivid rainbow colors.
